top_signals.title: Trailblazing artist Yayoi Kusama, ‘princess of polka dots,’ dies at 97
top_signals.summary: Kusama was known worldwide for her signature polka dots, repetitive patterns and immersive "Infinity Mirror Rooms."
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
